name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: An initiative by the Government of India that provides up to ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all small and marginal landholding farmer families as direct income support.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum distributed directly to bank accounts in 3 equal installments.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: The largest health assurance scheme in the world which aims to provide a health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to ₹500,000 per family per year at empaneled hospitals.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: A scheme to provide collateral-free micro loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises to scale business operations and promote entrepreneurship.
benefits: Collateral-free business development funds categorized from ₹50,000 up to ₹1,000,000.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: A small deposit savings scheme promoted under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign, explicitly meant to secure the financial future of a girl child including higher studies and marriage.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: High-interest savings account with absolute income tax exemptions under Section 80C.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: An initiative by the Government of India in which affordable housing is provided to the urban and rural poor with financial interest subsidies for building permanent pucca houses.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Financial interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakhs for house construction or purchase loans.
requiredDocuments: Affidavit declaring no existing pucca house

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: A skill certification scheme aimed at enabling a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant, placement-linked vocational skill training that helps secure a better livelihood.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free industry skill certification courses along with direct monetary rewards upon passing assessments.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNidhi
description: A special micro-credit facility scheme for providing affordable working capital loans to urban and rural street vendors to resume their businesses and secure self-reliance.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Initial working capital loan up to ₹10,000, scaling to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayments with 7% interest subsidy.

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
description: A comprehensive welfare scheme intended to facilitate delivery of assistive devices and free vocational training to persons with physical disabilities.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free aids, customized assistive devices, prosthetics distribution, and specialized educational setups.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: A comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing complete financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen natural calamities and pests.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Full insurance cover against crop failures with extremely low premium structures (1.5% to 5%).

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: A focused initiative promoting entrepreneurship at the grassroots level specifically targeting Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank loans ranging between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana
description: The Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana is a state-run social welfare initiative providing ₹2,500 per month (₹30,000 annually) directly to eligible women through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). It aims to promote financial independence, elevate socio-economic status, and help underprivileged women meet their daily household and personal expenses.Key Details & EligibilityFinancial Benefit: ₹2,500 per month deposited into an Aadhaar-seeded bank account.Age Limit: Women between the ages of 18 and 50 years.Residency: Must be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.Income Cap: The applicant's family must have an annual income of less than ₹8 lakh.Inclusions: Both married and unmarried women, as well as widows, who are registered on a valid ration card are eligible.Exclusions: The scheme does not apply to regular government employees, income-tax payers, or beneficiaries of other state social security pension schemes.
benefits: 30000 annualy
requiredDocuments: Passport Size Photograph and Filled Self-Declaration Form

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
hindiName: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
description: Provides financial subsidy up to ₹78,000 for residential rooftop solar panel installation, offering up to 300 units of free electricity every month to Indian households.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Up to ₹78,000 rooftop solar subsidy + up to 300 units of free electricity per month.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Provides holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople including PM Vishwakarma ID, basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% interest.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: ₹15,000 Toolkit Incentive + ₹1 Lakh to ₹3 Lakh Collateral-free loan at 5% interest + Vishwakarma Certificate.

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
description: A transformative initiative under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM aiming to empower 3 Crore rural women in Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to earn a sustainable annual income of at least ₹1 Lakh through skill training, micro-enterprises, and market linkage.
benefits: Skill training in drone piloting, tailoring, weaving, financial guidance, and collateral-free SHG credit linkage.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing a fixed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 upon reaching 60 years of age, depending on contribution amount.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 onwards with spouse pension benefits.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers like street vendors, rickshaw pullers, and domestic workers earning up to ₹15,000 monthly.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age with 50% government matching contribution.
requiredDocuments: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connections to adult women from BPL and impoverished households along with a free first LPG refill and stove.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Free LPG connection + 1 free gas stove + 1 free LPG cylinder refill + ₹300 per cylinder subsidy.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion providing zero-balance savings bank accounts with RuPay Debit Card, built-in ₹2 Lakh accident insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
benefits: Zero balance savings account + ₹2 Lakh RuPay Accidental Cover + ₹10,000 Overdraft facility.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: A renewable one-year term life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh death coverage due to any reason for an affordable premium of ₹436 per annum.
benefits: ₹200,000 life insurance death coverage auto-debited from bank account.
requiredDocuments: Bank Savings Account with Auto-Debit Consent

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: An accidental insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh coverage for accidental death/full disability and ₹1 Lakh for partial disability at an ultra-low premium of ₹20 per year.
benefits: ₹200,000 accidental death & total permanent disability coverage for ₹20/year.

name: PM POSHAN Scheme (Mid-Day Meal)
description: Provides hot cooked nutritious meals every school day to children studying in Classes I to VIII in government and government-aided schools to enhance nutritional levels and enrollment.
benefits: Free daily nutritious meal covering 450 to 700 calories to school children.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
hindiName: मनरेगा - महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days paid manual employment annually with statutory minimum daily wages directly deposited into bank accounts.

name: PM MITRA Textile Parks Scheme
description: Aims to build 7 Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks with world-class infrastructure to attract investments, spur manufacturing, and generate large-scale employment.
benefits: Development Capital Support up to ₹300 Crore per park + Competitive Incentive Support up to ₹30 Crore per unit.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Awarded to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage (Class IX to XII).
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class IX to XII.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Direct benefit transfer scheme providing financial incentive of ₹5,000 for 1st child and ₹6,000 for 2nd child (if a girl child) to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health care and nutrition.
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Cash incentive up to ₹6,000 directly transferred to mother's bank account.
requiredDocuments: MCP Card (Mother and Child Protection Card)

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
description: Nationwide infrastructure plan to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations in rural areas to foster economic growth.
benefits: Creation of single all-weather paved road infrastructure connecting rural habitations.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Provides generic, high-quality medicines and surgical items at affordable prices (50% to 90% cheaper than branded drugs) through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
benefits: Access to quality generic medicines at 50%-90% discounted rates.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for their cultivation needs, purchase of agriculture inputs, and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Revolving agricultural credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at effective interest rate of 4% (with prompt repayment subsidy).

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Issues soil health cards to farmers every 2 years carrying crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for their individual farm soil to improve productivity.
benefits: Free soil testing and customized fertilizer advisory report.

name: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
description: Flagship Odisha state welfare scheme providing financial assistance of ₹50,000 over 5 years (₹10,000 per year in two equal installments) to eligible women aged 21-60 to promote financial inclusion.
benefits: ₹10,000 per year directly credited into Aadhaar-enabled bank account on Raksha Bandhan & International Women's Day.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
description: Provides financial aid of ₹1,250 per month (₹15,000 annually) directly to women residents of Madhya Pradesh to support health, nutrition, and self-reliance.
benefits: ₹1,250 per month financial transfer directly via DBT into bank accounts.
requiredDocuments: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar & DBT

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana 2.0 (Madhya Pradesh)
description: Financial assistance program ensuring education, health, and career support for girl children in Madhya Pradesh, culminating in a lump sum payout of ₹1.43 Lakhs up to age 21.
benefits: Financial aid totaling ₹1,43,000 distributed at educational milestones including college admission grants.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Provides financial allowance of ₹1,500 per month to eligible women aged 21 to 65 years residing in Maharashtra to foster independence and economic security.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹1,500 deposited directly into applicant's bank account.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Financial empowerment scheme providing ₹2,000 per month to female heads of eligible households across Karnataka state.
benefits: ₹2,000 monthly direct cash transfer to female head of household.
requiredDocuments: Ration Card (BPL / APL / AAY listing woman as head)

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Provides free electricity up to 200 units per month to all residential households in Karnataka state.
benefits: Free monthly electricity consumption up to 200 units.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Unemployment financial assistance offering ₹3,000/month to degree graduates and ₹1,500/month to diploma holders who remain unemployed 6 months after graduation.
benefits: ₹3,000/month (Graduates) or ₹1,500/month (Diploma holders) for up to 2 years.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme aimed at improving the status and wellbeing of secondary school girls, preventing child marriage, and supporting higher studies.
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) + One-time grant of ₹25,000 upon reaching age 18 if unmarried and studying (K2).

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Provides basic income support to female heads of families in West Bengal, paying ₹1,000/month to general category women and ₹1,200/month to SC/ST women.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹1,000 (General) or ₹1,200 (SC/ST) deposited directly into bank accounts.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Financial assistance program providing ₹25,000 in six phased installments from the birth of a girl child through her higher education milestones.
benefits: Phased financial grants totaling ₹25,000 across birth, immunization, school entry, and degree admission.

name: UP BC Sakhi Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Deploys trained women as Banking Correspondent Sakhis in rural panchayats to deliver doorstep banking services, providing ₹4,000/month stipend for the first 6 months plus equipment grant.
benefits: ₹4,000/month stipend for 6 months + ₹75,000 loan for micro-ATM hardware + transaction commissions.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
description: Provides financial aid of ₹1,000 per month to female students who completed schooling in government schools from Class 6 to 12 until they finish their undergraduate degree or diploma.
benefits: ₹1,000 monthly allowance credited directly into college-going female students' bank accounts.
requiredDocuments: College ID Card / Admission Fee Receipt

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
description: Basic rights income grant providing ₹1,000 per month to 1.15 Crore eligible female family heads across Tamil Nadu.
benefits: ₹1,000 monthly direct cash transfer credited to women family heads.

name: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu (Telangana)
description: Investment support scheme for agriculture and horticulture crops offering financial aid per acre per year directly to farmers' bank accounts for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, and inputs.
benefits: Financial input assistance per acre of farm land transferred every crop season.

name: YSR Cheyutha (Andhra Pradesh)
description: Provides financial support of ₹75,000 over 4 years (₹18,750 per annum) to SC, ST, OBC, and minority women aged 45 to 60 years to set up sustainable micro-enterprises.
benefits: ₹18,750 annual cash grant for 4 consecutive years + enterprise setup assistance with Amul, P&G, and ITC.

name: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana (Odisha)
description: Provides financial pension assistance of ₹2,000 per month to traditional, folk, and veteran performing artists of Odisha who have contributed to cultural preservation.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 credited directly into the artist's bank account.
requiredDocuments: Artist Identity Card / Culture Dept Certificate

name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY Odisha)
description: Universal health coverage scheme in Odisha providing cashless health care up to ₹5 Lakhs per family (₹10 Lakhs for female family members) in empaneled private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless health treatment up to ₹10 Lakhs for women and ₹5 Lakhs for other family members per year.
requiredDocuments: BSKY Smart Health Card / NFSA / SFSS Ration Card

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: State housing initiative in Chhattisgarh offering ₹1.20 Lakhs to ₹1.30 Lakhs financial assistance to homeless rural families omitted from central survey lists.
benefits: ₹120,000 financial grant in installments to construct a permanent rural house.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Crop diversification and input support scheme giving financial aid up to ₹9,000 per acre to paddy, sugarcane, and pulse growers in Chhattisgarh.
benefits: Direct input subsidy up to ₹9,000 per acre transferred directly to farmers in 4 quarterly installments.

name: Bhagyalakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Financial security scheme for girl children born in BPL families in Karnataka, providing financial bonds and health insurance coverage up to age 18.
benefits: Maturity benefit of ₹1 Lakh upon reaching 18 years + ₹25,000 annual health cover.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (Jharkhand)
description: Direct financial input assistance scheme for small and marginal farmers in Jharkhand, providing ₹5,000 per acre per year (up to 5 acres).
benefits: ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 per year directly transferred to farmer's bank account.

name: Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme (Jharkhand)
description: Provides concessional education loans up to ₹15 Lakhs at a nominal interest rate of 4% simple interest for higher studies in recognized higher education institutions.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹15 Lakhs without collateral or third-party guarantee at 4% interest.

name: Abua Awas Yojana (Jharkhand)
description: State housing flagship scheme providing 3-room pucca houses with a financial assistance of ₹2 Lakhs in 4 installments to homeless and kutcha-house families in Jharkhand.
benefits: Financial aid of ₹200,000 to build a 3-room housing unit with clean kitchen.

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCCS)
description: Provides education loans up to ₹4 Lakhs at a subsidized interest rate of 4% (1% for women, PwD, and transgender students) for higher education after 12th standard.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹400,000 for general, professional, and technical courses.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (Bihar)
description: Provides total financial support of ₹50,000 from birth till graduation to promote girl child education, curb female foeticide, and eliminate child marriage in Bihar.
benefits: ₹50,000 total incentive transferred in phases including ₹25,000 upon passing 12th and ₹50,000 upon graduation.

name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (Bihar)
description: Provides financial support of ₹10 Lakhs (₹5 Lakhs grant + ₹5 Lakhs loan at 1% interest / 0% for women) to youth, women, SC, ST, and OBC candidates to start new micro-industries in Bihar.
benefits: ₹10 Lakh total package (50% grant + 50% low-interest loan with 84 easy installments).

name: Palanhar Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Provides monthly financial assistance and annual material allowance to foster families (palanhar) taking care of orphaned or vulnerable children in Rajasthan.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹1,500 (age 0-6) and ₹2,500 (age 6-18) + ₹2,000 annual clothes allowance.
requiredDocuments: Child Death Certificate of Parents / Orphan Proof

name: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooter Yojana (Rajasthan)
hindiName: कालीबाई भील मेधावी छात्रा स्कूटी योजना (राजस्थान)
description: Awards free motorized scooters along with 2 helmets, 1-year insurance, and 5-year third-party cover to meritorious female students of Rajasthan passing Class 12th with high marks.
benefits: Free motorized scooter + 2 helmets + registration + insurance coverage.
requiredDocuments: Class 12th Marksheet (65%+ for Board, 75%+ for CBSE)

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Chiranjeevi Health Insurance (Rajasthan)
hindiName: मुख्यमंत्री आयुष्मान चिरंजीवी स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना (राजस्थान)
description: Offers cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹25 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalizations across government and private empaneled hospitals in Rajasthan.
benefits: Cashless medical treatment cover up to ₹2,500,000 per family annually + ₹5 Lakh accidental cover.

name: Sukanya / Majhi Bhagyashree Kanya Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Financial incentive program in Maharashtra providing ₹50,000 bank fixed deposit in the name of a girl child born in a BPL family if the mother undergoes sterilization after one girl child.
benefits: ₹50,000 fixed deposit bond for single girl child or ₹25,000 each for two girl children.

name: Mukhyamantri Urban Awas Yojana (Himachal Pradesh)
description: Provides plot allocation or financial housing assistance up to ₹1.85 Lakhs to urban EWS homeless citizens residing in Himachal Pradesh for more than 20 years.
benefits: ₹185,000 construction grant or urban land plot allotment.
requiredDocuments: Urban Local Body Residence Proof (20 Years)

name: Ashirwad Scheme (Punjab)
description: Provides financial grant of ₹51,000 for the marriage of daughters belonging to SC, BC, Economically Weaker Section (EWS), and Christian/Muslim communities in Punjab.
benefits: One-time cash grant of ₹51,000 deposited directly into girl's bank account prior to marriage.

name: Farishtey Dilli Ke Scheme (Delhi)
description: Encourages citizens to rescue road accident, burn, and fire victims in Delhi by guaranteeing complete free treatment in private/public hospitals and awarding ₹2,000 cash incentive to good samaritans.
benefits: 100% free emergency medical treatment for accident victims + ₹2,000 award & citation for good samaritans.
requiredDocuments: Medical Emergency Admission Slip (No identity proof mandatory for immediate care)

name: PM-eBus Sewa Scheme
description: Aims to augment city bus operations by deploying 10,000 electric buses across 169 cities, creating green urban mobility infrastructure and lowering carbon emissions.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Enhanced eco-friendly public transit infrastructure and subsidized green urban mobility.

name: PM-PRANAM (Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment and Amelioration of Mother Earth)
description: Incentivizes Indian States and Union Territories to promote sustainable agriculture practices and balanced use of chemical, organic, and bio-fertilizers.
benefits: 50% grant of saved chemical fertilizer subsidy transferred to states for rural development.

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
description: Enables farmers to set up solar water pumps for irrigation and solar power plants on barren lands to generate clean energy and earn extra income.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Up to 60% government subsidy on solar pump installation + income from selling excess power.

name: SAMARTH (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector)
description: Skill development program aimed at providing demand-driven, placement-oriented skill training to youth in the organized textile and handloom industries.
benefits: Free accredited skill training with guaranteed wage employment linkage in textile manufacturing.

name: Agnipath Defence Enrollment Scheme
description: A recruitment scheme for Indian youth to serve in the Armed Forces as Agniveers for four years, building a skilled, disciplined military talent pool.
benefits: Monthly stipend + Seva Nidhi corpus package of ~₹11.71 Lakhs upon completion of 4-year tenure.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water-use efficiency on farm lands and expand cultivated area under assured irrigation.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers on installing drip & sprinkler irrigation systems.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Aims to bring about ecological and economic revolution in the fisheries sector by modernizing fish farming, cold chain logistics, and marine infrastructure.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: Financial grant up to 40% (60% for SC/ST/Women) on aquaculture projects and motorboat purchases.

name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship)
description: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) and Technology Business Incubators (TBI) to accelerate agro-rural entrepreneurship and local job creation.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefits: Grant support up to ₹1 Crore for setting up rural business incubators.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
hindiName: पीएम सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना
description: Provides financial, technical, and business support for the upgradation of existing micro food processing enterprises under One District One Product (ODOP).
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy up to 35% of eligible project cost with maximum cap of ₹10 Lakhs.

name: SEED (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNTs)
description: Provides coaching for competitive exams, health insurance, housing financial support, and livelihood upliftment for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNTs).
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free competitive exam coaching + Ayushman Bharat health card + ₹1.2 Lakh housing subsidy.

name: SHREYAS (Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills)
description: Provides top-class overseas education scholarships and national fellowships to SC and OBC students pursuing M.Phil, Ph.D., and post-doctoral research.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Full tuition fee payment + living stipend allowance for higher research abroad.

name: Vidyasaarathi Education Scholarship Portal
description: A corporate social responsibility (CSR) driven scholarship initiative matching deserving students with corporate foundation grants for higher professional studies.
benefits: Direct academic fee coverage up to ₹50,000 per academic year.

name: PM-DevINE (Prime Minister’s Development Initiative for North East Region)
description: Funds large-scale social development infrastructure, roads, healthcare, and livelihood generation projects across North Eastern states.
ministry: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
benefits: 100% central funding for infrastructure and livelihood projects across North Eastern states.

name: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology)
description: Uses drone technology to map inhabited rural land parcels and issue official Property Cards (Abadi land title deeds) to rural household owners.
benefits: Issuance of legal property ownership cards allowing villagers to utilize land as financial assets for loans.

name: Fit India Youth Club and Sports Grant
description: National movement encouraging citizens to incorporate physical activity, sports, and fitness into everyday life with grassroots equipment support for youth clubs.
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
benefits: Grants and official certification for registered Fit India Youth Clubs and schools.

name: Khelo India Talent Development Scheme
description: Identifies 1,000 talented young athletes nationwide every year across priority sports disciplines and supports them with financial aid and world-class training.
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
benefits: Annual out-of-pocket allowance of ₹1.2 Lakhs + ₹5 Lakhs annual sports training sponsorship for 8 years.

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Attracts top academic talent from IITs, IISc, NITs to pursue Ph.D. research programs at premier Indian institutions with high monthly stipends.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 + research grant of ₹2 Lakhs per year for 5 years.

name: DST INSPIRE Award - MANAK
description: Fosters creative thinking and science innovation among school students from classes 6th to 10th by awarding grants to build innovative science models.
benefits: Direct grant of ₹10,000 directly transferred into student's bank account to create a working prototype.

name: Dekho Apna Desh Travel Incentive Scheme
description: Encourages citizens to travel domestically and explore domestic heritage destinations, awarding certificates and travel grants to citizens visiting 15+ tourist sites.
benefits: National travel ambassador recognition + financial reimbursement of travel costs upon completing site pledges.

name: Swadesh Darshan 2.0 Tourism Development
description: Develops sustainable, responsible tourism circuits and homestays across tier-2 and tier-3 towns to empower local homestay owners and artisans.
benefits: Homestay infrastructure grant support + skill training for local tour guides.

name: e-SHRAM Portal Unorganized Worker Card
description: National database of unorganized workers offering a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN), free accidental insurance cover, and seamless social security integration.
benefits: Universal UAN card + ₹2 Lakh accidental death cover + direct delivery of emergency disaster relief funds.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training in industrial establishments by sharing stipend costs directly with employers via DBT to youth trainees.
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Monthly stipend reimbursement up to 25% (max ₹1,500/month per apprentice) directly deposited via DBT.

name: PM-DAKSH (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi)
description: Free skill development training program for SC, OBC, EBC, DNT and Safai Karamcharis through upskilling, re-skilling, short-term and long-term courses.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: 100% free skill training + stipend of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500/month during course tenure.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Provides financial and educational support to children who lost one or both parents due to COVID-19 or other fatal illnesses in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: ₹4,000 monthly allowance per child + free laptop/tablet for higher studies.

name: UP Gopalak Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
description: Provides subsidized bank loans to unemployed youth in Uttar Pradesh to establish commercial dairy farms with 10 to 20 milch animals.
benefits: Bank loan assistance up to ₹9 Lakhs with 5-year government interest subsidy.

name: Mukhyamantri Pariwar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY Haryana)
description: Provides social security life insurance, accident coverage, and pension contribution totaling ₹6,000 annually to underprivileged families in Haryana.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual direct benefit transfer / premium payment coverage per household.
requiredDocuments: Bank Account linked with Family ID

name: Chirayu Haryana Health Scheme
description: Expands Ayushman Bharat cashless health cover up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year to all Haryana households earning up to ₹1.80 Lakhs annually.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹500,000 per family annually in empaneled hospitals.

name: Mukhyamantri Sukh Ashraya Yojana (Himachal Pradesh)
description: Adopts orphaned children, destitute women, and senior citizens as 'Children of the State', providing free higher education, housing grants, and pocket money.
benefits: ₹4,000/month pocket allowance + 100% college fee coverage + ₹2 Lakh housing grant.

name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Andhra Pradesh)
description: Provides 100% full fee reimbursement directly into mothers' bank accounts for students pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, B.Tech, and Post-Graduate courses.
benefits: Full college tuition fee reimbursement credited quarterly to student's mother's account.

name: YSR Asara Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
description: Reimburses the outstanding bank loan amounts of Self-Help Group (SHG) women in four equal installments to liberate them from debt traps.
benefits: Direct financial payout reimbursing outstanding SHG bank loans in 4 annual installments.

name: MahaJyoti Free Coaching & Stipend (Maharashtra)
description: Provides free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, MPSC, JEE, NEET) and monthly stipends to OBC, VJNT, and SBC category students in Maharashtra.
benefits: Free exam coaching + ₹10,000/month stipend + ₹50,000 book grant for UPSC civil service aspirants.

name: Punjab Social Security Old Age Pension
description: Provides monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 directly to elderly citizens, widows, destitute women, and persons with disabilities in Punjab.
benefits: ₹1,500 monthly pension transferred directly via DBT into bank accounts.

name: Mukhya Mantri Swavalamban Yojana (Himachal Pradesh)
description: Promotes self-employment among Himachali youth aged 18 to 45 years by offering investment subsidies up to 35% on setting up machinery and equipment projects up to ₹1 Crore.
benefits: 25% to 35% capital subsidy on equipment investment + 5% interest subsidy for 3 years.

name: Delhi Pension Scheme for Persons with Special Needs
description: Provides monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500 to persons with severe disabilities (40% or more) residing in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
benefits: ₹2,500 per month disability pension transferred directly to bank account.

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme
description: Financial deposit assistance scheme in Delhi providing term deposits up to ₹100,000 for girl children from birth until passing Class 12th.
benefits: Financial maturity payout of ~₹100,000 upon passing 12th board exams and reaching 18 years of age.

name: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana (Delhi)
description: Offers 100% free pilgrimage travel packages (AC train, hotel stay, food, and sightseeing) across major holy sites in India for senior citizens residing in Delhi.
benefits: Fully sponsored pilgrimage tour covering transport, AC accommodation, meals, and attendant allowance.

name: Mukhyamantri Amrutam & Vatsalya Scheme (Gujarat)
description: Cashless medical treatment scheme offering health coverage up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for catastrophic illnesses in Gujarat.
benefits: 100% cashless hospital treatment cover up to ₹500,000 per family annually.

name: Vhali Dikri Yojana (Gujarat)
description: Financial assistance scheme in Gujarat promoting girl child education and preventing female foeticide, providing up to ₹1.10 Lakhs in three stages.
benefits: ₹4,000 (Class 1 entry) + ₹6,000 (Class 9 entry) + ₹100,000 at age 18 for higher education or marriage.

name: SAUNI Yojana (Saurashtra Narmada Avtaran Irrigation, Gujarat)
description: Fills 115 dams across drought-prone Saurashtra region using excess Narmada flood waters to provide year-round drinking and irrigation water.
benefits: Guaranteed canal water supply for agricultural irrigation across 8 Lakh acres.

name: Sabooj Sathi Bicycle Distribution Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Distributes free bi-cycles to students studying in Classes IX to XII in government and government-aided schools to reduce dropouts and promote mobility.
benefits: 100% free branded bi-cycle distributed directly at school.
requiredDocuments: School Student Registration Number / Class IX-XII ID Card

name: Swasthya Sathi Universal Health Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Universal health insurance scheme in West Bengal providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care up to ₹5 Lakhs per family per year, issued in the name of female head.
benefits: Cashless health coverage up to ₹500,000 annually per family with no top capping.
requiredDocuments: Swasthya Sathi Smart Card / Khadya Sathi Ration Card

name: Duare Sarkar Outreach Initiative (West Bengal)
description: Doorstep government service camp initiative delivering instant registration and grievance resolution for 30+ state welfare schemes at neighborhood camps.
benefits: Instant door-step application processing and verification for pension, ration, and housing schemes.

name: Mo Ghara Rural Housing Credit Scheme (Odisha)
description: Credit-linked housing assistance providing bank loans up to ₹3 Lakhs with capital subsidy for lower and lower-middle-income rural households in Odisha to upgrade kutcha homes.
benefits: Bank loan up to ₹3 Lakhs with upfront government capital subsidy up to ₹60,000.

name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation, Odisha)
description: Provides direct financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for small/marginal farmers and ₹12,500 for landless agricultural laborers for cultivation and livelihood sustenance.
benefits: ₹10,000 annual direct cash support transferred in 2 seasonal installments (Kharif and Rabi).
requiredDocuments: Small/Marginal Farmer Certificate or Landless Laborer ID

name: Godhan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Procures cow dung at ₹2/kg and urine at ₹4/liter from cattle rearers and farmers to produce vermicompost and bio-pesticides, boosting rural organic economy.
benefits: Direct income for cattle rearers + promotion of organic farming inputs.

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Provides financial aid of ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 annually) directly to married women aged 21 and above residing in Chhattisgarh state.
benefits: ₹1,200 monthly cash allowance credited directly via DBT into beneficiary women's accounts.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Gopal Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Provides free fortified milk twice a week to students studying in Classes 1 to 8 in government schools and madrasas across Rajasthan to eliminate malnutrition.
benefits: 150ml (Class 1-5) or 200ml (Class 6-8) fresh milk served twice a week in school.

name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Sponsors 30,000+ meritorious students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, EWS, and PwD categories annually for free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, REET, NEET, IIT-JEE).
benefits: 100% free entrance coaching + ₹40,000 annual boarding & lodging stipend for outstation students.

name: Mukhyamantri Vriksh Sampada Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
description: Provides 100% subsidy (up to 5 acres) for commercial tree plantation (Teak, Eucalyptus, Bamboo) on private lands to generate commercial timber income for farmers.
benefits: 100% grant for tree saplings + guaranteed buyback price by State Forest Department.

name: Arundhati Gold Scheme (Assam)
description: Provides financial grant of ₹40,000 to newlywed brides from economically weaker families in Assam to purchase 1 Tola (10 grams) of gold for marriage.
benefits: ₹40,000 direct benefit transfer credited to bride's bank account prior to wedding.
